_comment: Single source of truth for the look (RESEARCH_BRIEF.md §1.2–1.3). Nothing is styled per video. Change a value here, re-run `npm run check` and `npm run contact-sheet`, and approve the new snapshots on purpose.

colors._comment: Neutrals: ink, paper, white. Accents: signature (the stickman's tie ONLY), money, loss, highlight. Never add a color without updating docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md.

scale._comment: 1 head unit (HU) = the stickman's head height. All characters and props are sized in HU and drawn at this one scale.

wobble._comment: Hand-drawn line character. segmentPx = resample spacing, wavelengthPx = distance between noise peaks, overshootPx = max extension of straight line ends.

boil._comment: Line boil: wobble is re-seeded `fps` times per second (animating on twos at 30 fps would be 15; we use 10 = on threes).

fonts._comment: All SIL Open Font License. Files live in assets/fonts/ (caption font is added with the renderer).

layout._comment: Content-led stacked split (brief §1.6). Safe-zone values are common creator guidance, NOT verified against the current TikTok UI (brief TODO).
